## Resource model

The system models books as a single resource with id, title, author and availability fields.

## Endpoints

The HTTP surface exposes `GET /books`, `POST /books`, `GET /books/{id}` and `PUT /books/{id}`.","sources":["sk_000"],"density":0.7,"schema_version":"v1"}
